title: WeddingGuest
description: A person on a wedding's guest list (issue #27), in exactly one household of that wedding. Distinct from the `guest` contract (the messaging binding of an opaque sender ref). Owned by one tenant and one wedding; always reached through a tenant-scoped repository keyed (tenant_id, guest_id) and filtered by wedding_id. Contact details are personal data: never logged, shown only to the wedding's planner and couple.

guest_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, from the injected id generator.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

household_id.description: The household of the same wedding the guest belongs to.

last_name.description: May be empty (a plus-one whose name is not known yet is 'Guest of …' by first name).

side.description: Whose guest: the first partner's, the second's, or both.

tags.description: Free labels the planner and couple use (e.g. 'family', 'college'). At most 20 (enforced by the guest-list service: a maxItems here would generate a tuple type).

plus_one_allowed.description: Whether this guest may bring a plus-one. Always false for a plus-one.

plus_one_of.description: Present iff this guest IS a plus-one: the guest_id of the guest who brings them (same wedding and household).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time, from the injected clock.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last edit, when edited.
